statementCatalog.23ece887411e1ba243041ae87f4ba02f5dfd143a:
with benchmarks as (
      select benchmark.id from "published"."observation" source
      join "published"."observation" benchmark on benchmark.indicator_id = source.indicator_id
        and benchmark.area_id = $1::uuid
        and benchmark.dimension_key = source.dimension_key
        and benchmark.from_date = source.from_date and benchmark.to_date = source.to_date
      where source.id = any($2::uuid[])
    ), wanted as (select unnest($3::uuid[]) as id union select id from benchmarks)
    , points as materialized (
      select o.* from "published"."observation" o where o.id = any(array(select id from wanted))
    ), dimensions as materialized (
      select k.dimension_key, coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        $4, dt.name, $5, dv.name, $6, dt.dimension_class,
        $7, dv.sort_order) order by dt.name) filter (where dv.id is not null), $8::jsonb) as data
      from (select distinct dimension_key from points) k
      left join lateral unnest(string_to_array(k.dimension_key, $9)::uuid[]) key(id) on $10
      left join "published"."dimension_value" dv on dv.id = key.id
      left join "published"."dimension_type" dt on dt.id = dv.dimension_type_id
      group by k.dimension_key
    ), notes as materialized (
      select n.observation_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($11, nt.text,
        $12, nt.category) order by nt.id) as data
      from "published"."observation_note" n join "published"."note_type" nt on nt.id = n.note_type_id
      where n.observation_id = any(array(select id from wanted))
      group by n.observation_id
    )
    select o.id, o.indicator_id as "indicatorId", o.area_id as "areaId", jsonb_build_object(
      $13, o.from_date, $14, o.to_date, $15, o.value,
      $16, o.count, $17, o.numerator, $18, o.denominator,
      $19, o.lower_ci_95, $20, o.upper_ci_95,
      $21, o.lower_ci_998, $22, o.upper_ci_998,
      $23, d.data, $24, coalesce(n.data, $25::jsonb)
    ) as point from points o join dimensions d on d.dimension_key = o.dimension_key
    left join notes n on n.observation_id = o.id
